:::{#exr-linear-scalar-practice}
#### Finding the weight vector of a linear score

A linear score of $p$ measurements is a [dot product](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-dot-product) of the measurements with a vector of [weights](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-weight),
by @cor-linear-scalar.
Let $f: \reals^3 \to \reals$ be a [linear map](#def-linear-map) with

$$
f(\vecf{e}_1) = 2,
\qquad
f(\vecf{e}_2) = 0,
\qquad
f(\vecf{e}_3) = -1.
$$

Find the vector $\vec{w}$ with $f(\vx) = \dprod{\vec{w}}{\vx}$ for every $\vx \in \reals^3$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

@cor-linear-scalar gives each entry $w_j$ of $\vec{w}$.

:::

:::
